title: Thailand province administrative boundaries (display layer)
attribution: Royal Thai Survey Department; OCHA/HDX; geographic conversion by prasertcbs/thailand_gis; GeoJSON adaptation by AP Water Watch.
crs: WGS84 geographic coordinates; GeoJSON longitude, latitude (EPSG:4326)
transformations: Decode TopoJSON delta-encoded shared arcs and negative arc references.
Preserve source Polygon/MultiPolygon topology and every source vertex; no additional simplification or reprojection.
Round coordinates to six decimal places (sub-metre precision; source quantization is coarser).
Normalize polygon winding to RFC 7946 (outer counterclockwise, holes clockwise).
Retain province code and Thai/English names; derive feature and collection bounding boxes; omit unrelated date/sentinel/area fields.
useLimit: Generalized administrative reference only; not survey precision, flood extent, catchment, hydrologic connectivity, project boundary, or confirmation of current legal boundaries.
validation: 77 unique province codes/names; finite coordinates within Thailand bounds; connected source arcs; closed nondegenerate rings; RFC 7946 winding. Browser rendering and formal polygon self-intersection validation pending.
